evidence: Market sentiment as tracked by the Alternative.me Fear & Greed Index sits at 34 ('Fear'), sliding 4 points from the prior two days (38) and well below both the 7-day average (42.14) and 30-day average (49.93). Following a severe drop from Greed (64-74 range) in early October down to Extreme Fear (24 on Oct 12), the modest relief attempt stalled at 38 and resumed weakening. While extreme fear can occasionally trigger contrarian mean-reversion, moderate fear accompanied by a downward step-off indicates fragile risk appetite and prevailing selling pressure over a 24-hour horizon, pointing to a slightly below-neutral probability of upward price movement.
limitations: Fear & Greed Index reflects composite market indicators with a 24-hour reporting cadence and does not capture intraday sentiment shifts.
Sentiment metrics are non-directional leading indicators and can produce false contrarian signals during established trends.
Snapshot availability and later revisions are caller-attested, not independently verified.
